description: An 8-bit blip voice: one oscillator crossfading between a pulse wave and a falling sawtooth, shaped by a hold-and-release envelope

params.text: Sets the pitch, from 54 semitones below C4 at 261.63Hz to 54 semitones above it
Crossfades the oscillator from a pulse wave at its minimum to a falling sawtooth at its maximum
Sets the width of the pulse wave, from 1% to 99%; with BLND fully over to the sawtooth the pulse is out of the mix and this does nothing
Sets how long the envelope holds at full level before the release begins, from 1ms to 250ms
Sets how long the envelope takes to fall in a straight line from full level to nothing, from 0ms to 250ms

inputs.text: Adds to the pitch set by FREQ at one volt per octave, read at the moment the trigger arrives
Adds to the crossfade set by BLND, a tenth of its travel per volt
Adds to the width set by PW, a tenth of its travel per volt
Doubles the time set by HOLD per volt and halves it per volt below zero, read at the moment the trigger arrives
Doubles the time set by REL per volt and halves it per volt below zero, read at the moment the trigger arrives
Starts a note when it rises past 2V, and has to fall back below 0.1V before another note can start

outputs.text: The envelope as a voltage from 0V to 10V, quantised to 127 steps
The voice, quantised to 127 steps and clipped at 5V either way

notes: With nothing patched into TRIG the envelope is held wide open and the oscillator drones. It only shapes the sound once a trigger cable is in.
The pitch, the hold time and the release time are read once, at the moment TRIG fires; moving those controls during a note has no effect until the next one.

inputs.0: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
inputs.1:
continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
